mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with declining FEDFUNDS is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.0% in a 3-month window, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% (over 3-year rolling window) or the Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust labor market expansion driving stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS and RSAFS does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), rising housing starts (HOUST) signals resilient consumer demand that offsets inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and HOUST is rising (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in labor force participation (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in periods with rising PAYEMS is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 (over 3-year rolling window) or the Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates contractionary supply shock combined with monetary tightening, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of INDPRO and rise of FEDFUNDS does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annually), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals imminent manufacturing slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 3.0% and INDPRO is declining (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is negative.
